description: Land Title Settlement Department - Udaaludeniya, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320237 (23/0505)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically declarations of determination regarding land parcels under the Registration of Title Act.
